description: Defines data structures related to Uplink PUSCH (Physical Uplink Shared Channel) in 5G NR, including data, UCI, and PDU information, with various configuration parameters and related includes.

classes.name: ul_pusch_data
classes.description: Contains information about PUSCH data, including redundancy version index, HARQ process ID, data validity, and transport block size.

classes.name: ul_pusch_uci
classes.description: Contains Uplink Control Information (UCI) related to PUSCH, including HARQ acknowledgment bits, CSI bits, alpha scaling, and beta offsets.

classes.name: ul_pusch_pdu
classes.description: Represents the PUSCH Protocol Data Unit (PDU) with various configuration parameters, including transform precoding settings, resource allocations, and optional data and UCI.
